# 🎯 Phase 1 Epic: Enhanced CI Foundation

## Overview
Enhance the current CI pipeline with security scanning, performance monitoring, and robust testing to create a bulletproof foundation for VanitySSH development.

## Goals
- ✅ 100% test coverage maintained
- ✅ Security vulnerabilities = 0  
- ✅ Performance regression detection
- ✅ Sub-5-minute CI feedback

## Phase 1 Tasks

### Security & Quality
- [ ] Add security scanning (cargo audit + Dependabot)
- [ ] Enhance testing with stress tests and integration tests

### Performance & Optimization  
- [ ] Implement performance benchmarking with Criterion.rs
- [ ] Optimize CI caching and parallel execution

## Success Criteria
- [x] All current tests pass
- [ ] Security vulnerabilities automatically detected
- [ ] Performance benchmarks run on every PR
- [ ] CI feedback time under 5 minutes
- [ ] Memory usage and stress testing in place

## Timeline
**Target:** Week 1-2

`epic`, `phase-1`, `ci/cd`, `priority-high`

Part of comprehensive CI/CD improvement plan for VanitySSH multi-platform release automation.
